desc: Parse N and the string A from stdin; validate length is 3^N. (folded into implementation task)
Design DP: leaf cost pairs (c0, c1); parent cost for value v = sum of two smallest among children's costs for v.
Decide bottom-up level-by-level reduction with compact encoding to control memory.
Implement solve(): read input, build encoded leaf array, iteratively reduce triples (f_v_new = sum - max), decode root, print cost of forcing opposite value.
Mentally verify correctness on samples (010011101 → 1; 000 → 2) and edge cases (N=1, uniform strings).
